graph.title: Stephanie and Mailbox
notes: The 2-group warning is not a real problem for this set. The booklet builds two separate models. Page 1 left builds the mailbox (b1-b5). Page 1 middle and right, then page 2, build the flower stand (b6-b36). No step joins the mailbox to the stand, and the final picture shows them standing side by side. I kept them as two groups and added no join between them.

The envelope tile b37 is the letter Stephanie holds. Stephanie is not in the parts list, so she has no nodes, and no step fastens the tile to anything. I added one contact edge between b37 and the mailbox door b3, on the assumption that the letter fits the mailbox slot. This keeps the tile from being an isolated node. If you would rather leave it unconnected, remove that edge.

The booklet pictures are low-resolution, so the exact stud positions in the stand, roof and heart are my best reading. Treat the stud-level port mapping as approximate. The piece-to-piece connections follow the steps.

Ports on the cones (lego-59900) and on the flower stem (lego-3741) are null where the catalogue port list does not cover the join. The supports (b14, b15) sit on the cones. The flowers b19 and b20 sit on the stem.

The roof (b27 with the red jumper b28, red brick b29, slopes b30-b33 and side-stud brick b34) is built in the side steps 1-3 and fitted onto the gold supports in step 7. The heart is two red 3x2 round plates (b35, b36) stacked in step 8.
The hinge b10/b11 is a revolute join. Its red lid b21 is shown tilted in step 5.
The brown round plates sit on the black plate in step 6 with the two pink ones. That plate is then placed on the stand (b16).
